archetypes.name: dyn-auth-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The change threads a security-sensitive authorization triple through shell and Python lifecycle callers.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect every non-dry-run cross-repository helper invocation and direct design authorization check. Confirm each uses the authoritative session tmpdir and matching run ID, never a root derived from the context path. Verify refusal remains before any GitHub mutation and preserves the existing machine status grammar. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
